Decouple runner from UI theme

Move all styled formatting out of StepManager and orchestrate.rs
into the display trait layer. The runner now communicates what to
render via StatusKind enums and plain strings; display
implementations decide how to style them.

- Add StepDisplay::show_status for status lines (satisfied,
  skipped, blocked) — each display impl controls its own styling.
- Add WorkflowDisplay::show_filtered_step for pre-filtered steps
  excluded by --skip flags or environment mismatch.
- Remove BivvyTheme from StepManager and orchestrate.rs — neither
  imports concrete UI types anymore.
- Remove unused step_number/step_indent params from
  execute_step_with_recovery; derive indent from step_display.
EOF
)"

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Decouple runner from UI theme

Move all styled formatting out of StepManager and orchestrate.rs
into the display trait layer. The runner now communicates what to
render via StatusKind enums and plain strings; display
implementations decide how to style them.

- Add StepDisplay::show_status for status lines (satisfied,
  skipped, blocked) — each display impl controls its own styling.
- Add WorkflowDisplay::show_filtered_step for pre-filtered steps
  excluded by --skip flags or environment mismatch.
- Remove BivvyTheme from StepManager and orchestrate.rs — neither
  imports concrete UI types anymore.
- Remove unused step_number/step_indent params from
  execute_step_with_recovery; derive indent from step_display.
EOF
)"

    Decouple runner from UI theme
    
    Move all styled formatting out of StepManager and orchestrate.rs
    into the display trait layer. The runner now communicates what to
    render via StatusKind enums and plain strings; display
    implementations decide how to style them.

    - Add WorkflowDisplay::show_filtered_step for pre-filtered steps
      excluded by --skip flags or environment mismatch.
    - Remove BivvyTheme from StepManager and orchestrate.rs — neither
      imports concrete UI types anymore.
    - Remove unused step_number/step_indent params from
      execute_step_with_recovery; derive indent from step_display.
